63:t_1:4.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「...You ran away from the $$サイデリアル$$, is that what you're telling me?」

63:t_1:6.en:
$$海賊$$
「Just as we thought, our boss can be no one but the great pirate $$ラケージ$$!」

63:t_1:9.en:
$$海賊$$
「We... we're ready to work for $$ラケージ$$ with our lives on the line!」

63:t_1:12.en:
$$海賊$$
「We're sorry! We're sorry! Please, just spare our lives...!」

63:t_1:13.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「I'm not talking about you lot.」

63:t_1:15.en:
$$海賊$$
「D-Do you mean the $$サイデリアル$$?」

63:t_1:16.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Naturally, them too... But the ones who displease me most are those people...」

63:t_1:17.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「The $$ガルガンティア船団$$.」

63:t_1:19.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「I've thought they displeased me for some time now, but my patience is about to reach its limit.」

63:t_1:20.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「They'll learn what happens to those who look down on us... Whatever secret weapon they may have, it is no match for me and my $$ラケージ$$ Pirates.」

63:t_1:25.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[...I can find no logic in your actions. Requesting the reason for maintaining a stalemate.]

63:t_1:26.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Against the forces currently surrounding us, this unit is equipped with armament necessary and sufficient to defeat or break through them.]

63:t_1:27.en:
$$レド$$
[But if we are surrounded by allied units seized by the natives who ran a joint operation with us, we won't stand a chance.]

63:t_1:28.en:
$$レド$$
[For now, waiting for our chance like this is the best course.]

63:t_1:29.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Valid proposal. 1. Overwhelm and suppress the forces surrounding us. 2. Seize the nerve center and block any resistance.]

63:t_1:30.en:
$$レド$$
[Chamber, our top priority right now is contacting friendly forces and pinpointing our current position...]

63:t_1:31.en:
$$レド$$
[And investigating why the $$サイデリアル$$ are deploying forces on this planet at the edge of the galaxy.]

63:t_1:32.en:
$$レド$$
[As for our position, if you can't analyze it, it's also an option to count on the historical records these people have.]

63:t_1:33.en:
$$レド$$
[No... if we're gathering information, that starship, clearly of a different civilization level, is better suited.]

63:t_1:35.en:
$$レド$$
[What matters is that this Earth is alive as a planet. According to the Alliance's records, Earth should have become a dead planet. But the reality is this.]

63:t_1:37.en:
$$レド$$
[Securing a habitable planet is the Alliance's long-cherished wish. With this much water and air... this may become a new base to replace 《$$アヴァロン$$》.]

63:t_1:38.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Proposal. Inferred to be a judgment beyond the scope of your duties.]

63:t_1:39.en:
$$レド$$
[Heh... you're right. ...How about contact with the Alliance?]

63:t_1:40.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Distress signal continues, but there is still no response. If solo operations continue, necessary logistics cannot be obtained, and your metabolism will suffer.]

63:t_1:41.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Valid proposal 3. Consideration should be given to leaving this environment and returning to artificial hibernation...]

63:t_1:45.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[No armament observed. Inferred to be negotiators.]

63:t_1:46.en:
$$レド$$
[You've finished analyzing their language system, right? Tell them we have no hostile intent.]

63:t_1:47.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「We have no hostile intent.」

63:t_1:49.en:
$$キャシー$$
「As Warrant Officer $$ルカ$$ surmised, it seems to be some kind of support AI.」

63:t_1:50.en:
$$リジット$$
「Anyway, if we can exchange intentions with it, we may be able to manage somehow...」

63:t_1:51.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I will say it again. We have no hostile intent.」

63:t_1:52.en:
$$リジット$$
「I am $$リジット$$, assistant to this fleet's representative, and this is my collaborator, Lieutenant $$キャサリン・グラス$$. We have come here to talk.」

63:t_1:53.en:
$$リジット$$
「Answer our question. Who are you?」

63:t_1:54.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[She is requesting that you state your full name and affiliation.]

63:t_1:56.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Anti-$$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ annihilation weapon, $$チェインバー#robot$$. Pilot, Ensign $$レド$$.」

63:t_1:57.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Ensign... So he's a soldier...」

63:t_1:58.en:
$$リジット$$
「What is a $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$?」

63:t_1:60.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「You are to rally to the $$人類銀河同盟$$. We demand dialogue. Who is the commanding officer?」

63:t_1:61.en:
$$リジット$$
「...What do we do, $$キャシー$$?」

63:t_1:62.en:
$$キャシー$$
「We have confirmed he bears no hostility, but because his civilization and way of life differ from ours, our common sense and premises may not carry over to each other.」

63:t_1:63.en:
$$キャシー$$
「First, I believe it is important to follow the principles of inter-civilization communication and look for common ground.」

63:t_1:66.en:
$$キャシー$$
「As $$ガロード$$ reported, the word endings and grammar change somewhat, but it seems he can speak Standard Earth language, more or less.」

63:t_1:67.en:
$$キャシー$$
「If we take the time, we should be able to communicate with him directly.」

63:t_1:69.en:
$$リジット$$
「$$エイミー$$...! What on earth are you doing...!?」

63:t_1:70.en:
$$エイミー$$
「What am I doing? ...I brought that kid his breakfast.」

63:t_1:71.en:
$$リジット$$
「Wait, $$エイミー$$! It hasn't been confirmed safe yet...」

63:t_1:72.en:
$$エイミー$$
「It's okay. If he were going to do something bad, he'd have done it long ago.」

63:t_1:74.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Good morning. Um... this is your breakfast. It's dried horse mackerel.」

63:t_1:75.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[It is the carcass of an aquatic organism.]

63:t_1:76.en:
$$レド$$
[A carcass!? What am I supposed to do with this!?]

63:t_1:77.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Inferred to be food.]

63:t_1:78.en:
$$レド$$
[Don't tell me they expect me to eat it...!]

63:t_1:79.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Inferred to be a ritual of friendship.]

63:t_1:81.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[The decision is left to you.]

63:t_1:85.en:
$$エイミー$$
「I'm $$エイミー$$. Thanks for helping the fleet yesterday.」
